sentences.text: The Criminal Original Petition has been filed to quash the FIR in Crime No. 737 of 2022, pending on the file of the 1st respondent.

2.From the records, it appears that when the matter came up for admission on 06.02.2023, this Court has ordered notice to the second respondent/defacto complainant and also directed the respondent police to continue with the investigation but defer the filing of the final report.
From the perusal of the records, this Court finds that it is the complaint for offences under Sections 498A and 506(i) of IPC lodged by the wife against her husband and in-laws.

In view of the Hon'ble Supreme Court judgment rendered in Kahkshan Kausar @ Sonam and Others vs. State of Bihar and others reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599, the matter being matrimonial dispute, the 5th accused, who is the brother of A2 has sought for quash of the complaint against him.

entities.text: Kahkshan Kausar @ Sonam and Others vs. State of Bihar and others reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Reading of the complaint attributes overt act against the petitioner and only after completion of investigation, whether he has been falsely implicated or not will come to light.
Therefore, the Criminal Original https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to challenge the final report if necessary after filing the final report.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
